subject: 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493
fact: The events occur on the 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493.
source_quote: ## 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493

subject: Daz
fact: Daz has experience dealing with Drow leaders suffering from delusions of grandeur, paranoia, and megalomania.
source_quote: Daz has a lot of experience in dealing with leaders suffering from delusions of grandeur, paranoia, and megalomania.

subject: Lolth
fact: Lolth became Lolth through betrayal and subterfuge.
source_quote: Lolth became Lolth through betrayal and subterfuge.

subject: Correlon
fact: Correlon was the consort of Lolth, or vice versa, according to conflicting accounts.
source_quote: Correlon, the chief elvish god, was her consort, or she was his, it’s unclear

subject: banishment of Lolth
fact: Correlon banished Lolth after her followers tried to kill his priests.
source_quote: Correlon banished her, and the elves banished her followers.

subject: banishment of Drow followers
fact: The elves banished the followers of Lolth.
source_quote: Correlon banished her, and the elves banished her followers.

subject: Feywild
fact: The banishment of Lolth occurred in the Feywild.
source_quote: the banishment occurred in the Feywild

subject: Underdark in the Feywild
fact: From the Underdark in the Feywild, the Drow fled to every part of the multiverse.
source_quote: from the Underdark in the Feywild, the Drow fled to every part of the multiverse

subject: Drow
fact: The term 'Drow' was used to describe the followers of Lolth.
source_quote: The ancient word “Drow” was used to describe the followers of Lolth.

subject: meaning of 'Drow'
fact: The meaning of the word 'Drow' has been lost even to the wisest of Elves.
source_quote: What it means has been lost even to the wisest of Elves

subject: noble houses
fact: In Drow cities dominated by Lolth’s cult, society is organized around noble houses.
source_quote: In the cities where Lolth’s cult dominates, society is organized around noble houses.

subject: destruction of a noble house
fact: A noble house was destroyed by the combined might of other noble houses because one child survived.
source_quote: Daz remembers, or was it a story he heard, of a noble house destroyed by the combined might of the other noble houses because one child survived.

subject: Errde
fact: Errde is a Duergar leader suffering from paranoia and a desire for power.
source_quote: And so now he is on his way to Errde’s office. And the stench of paranoia runs deep. And the desire for power is palpable.

subject: Grey Ghosts
fact: Errde believes the Grey Ghosts are allied with the Council of Savants.
source_quote: She wants proof of the Grey Ghosts' alliance with the Council of Savants.

subject: Council of Savants
fact: The Council of Savants is a ruling group of the Derro.
source_quote: the Council of Savants, a ruling group of the Derro

subject: Deepking
fact: Errde believes the Council of Savants is corrupting the Deepking.
source_quote: She is blinded by her conviction that the Council of Savants... is corrupting the Deepking.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido, before he became mad as The Flumph, complained about the Council of Savants prioritizing power over freedom.
source_quote: Buppido, before he became mad, as The Flumph, complained about how the Council was more interested in staying in power than freeing his people.

subject: Keepers of the Flame
fact: The Keepers of the Flame want the destruction of the Derro.
source_quote: the Keepers of the Flame and Stone Guard want the same thing: the destruction of the Derro.

subject: Stone Guard
fact: The Stone Guard want the destruction of the Derro.
source_quote: the Keepers of the Flame and Stone Guard want the same thing: the destruction of the Derro.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin survived the War of the Giants when the ordning fell apart.
source_quote: Thorin had survived the War of the Giants when the ordning fell apart

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir was taught by monks to be discreet, hide in shadows, and avoid frontal conflict.
source_quote: The monks who taught Zalthir the importance of being discreet, of hiding in the shadows, and of avoiding frontal conflict.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum insists that the group must honor their commitments.
source_quote: But Grygum insists that they must honor their commitments.

subject: Overlake Hold
fact: The group goes to Overlake Hold to talk to Errde.
source_quote: Zalthir sighed and followed the group to Overlake Hold to talk to Errde.

subject: The Flumph
fact: The Flumph says trauma dumps are no longer as satisfying.
source_quote: The Flumph mutters - “I need more trauma. These dumps are no longer as satisfying.”

subject: Errde claims Grey Ghosts and Council are allied
fact: Errde claims she knew the Grey Ghosts and the Council were working together.
source_quote: “I knew the Grey Ghosts and the Council were working together!”

subject: Daz denies evidence of alliance
fact: Daz says he doesn’t know that the Grey Ghosts and the Council are working together.
source_quote: “I don’t know that’s the case.”

subject: Errde demands papers
fact: Errde demands that Daz bring her the papers he failed to obtain.
source_quote: “Drow, you knew this was not enough. Why didn’t you bring me the papers?”

subject: Daz cites cave dangers
fact: Daz says they ran into trouble in the caves because they are not as safe as they once were.
source_quote: “We did some searching and ran into trouble. The caves are not as safe as they once were. We ran into some trouble.”

subject: Grygum requests reinforcements
fact: Grygum says they needed reinforcements.
source_quote: Grygum then interjects, “We needed reinforcements.”

subject: Clan Ironhead
fact: Clan Ironhead is forbidden from taking weapons directly and may only take surplus orders from Clan Steelshadow.
source_quote: Clan Ironhead is forbidden from taking weapons directly and may only take surplus orders from Clan Steelshadow.

subject: Clan Steelshadow
fact: The Deepking has been sending all orders to Clan Steelshadow.
source_quote: The Deepking has been sending all orders to his clan, Clan Steelshadow.

subject: Clan Xardelva
fact: Clan Xardelva is worried their work will be seen as too similar to weaponsmithing and will be taken over by Clan Steelshadow.
source_quote: As for Clan Xardelva, they are worried that their work will be seen as too similar to weaponsmithing, and Clan Steelshadow will take them over.

subject: Shattered Spire
fact: The Shattered Spire is a tavern built on a broken stalagmite jutting from the Darklake.
source_quote: The tavern known as the Shattered Spire... built on a broken stalagmite that juts out from the Darklake about forty feet from the shore.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Shattered Spire is located about forty feet from the shore of the Darklake.
source_quote: built on a broken stalagmite that juts out from the Darklake about forty feet from the shore.

subject: rothé wool bridge
fact: A bridge woven of rothé wool connects the shore to the Shattered Spire.
source_quote: Grygum has to cross a bridge woven of rothé wool to get to it.

subject: gemstone
fact: Werz hands Grygum and each companion a gemstone worth 10 gold pieces.
source_quote: he hands Grygum and each of his companions a gemstone worth 10 gold pieces.

subject: Flumph's gemstone
fact: The Flumph’s gemstone turns light blue, then green, then magenta before falling to the ground.
source_quote: The Flumph turns light blue. Then , when it turns green, it picks the stone up and plays with it in its tentacles. After a while, it turns magenta, and the stone falls to the ground.

subject: Grygum steals Flumph's gem
fact: Grygum picks up the Flumph’s gem and puts it in his bag when no one is looking.
source_quote: When no one is looking, Grygum picks up the Flumph’s gem and puts it in his bag.

subject: Werz
fact: Werz is a Duergar merchant who claims to have spoken to the owner of Gholbrorn’s Inn.
source_quote: I have already spoken to the owner of the Gholbrorn’s Inn, and I will take care of everything.

subject: Gholbrorn’s Inn
fact: Werz claims to have spoken to the owner of Gholbrorn’s Inn.
source_quote: I have already spoken to the owner of the Gholbrorn’s Inn

subject: assassin's guild
fact: Werz claims assassins are not his enemies but professionals, and that he did not hire them.
source_quote: First, assassins are not your enemies. They are professionals. And before you ask, I did try to offer them a higher rate, but they are professionals.

subject: assassin's guild
fact: Grygum suggests Werz may have hired assassins and now is being targeted by another party.
source_quote: Maybe he ordered somebody to assassinate somebody, and now somebody else found out and they have ordered somebody to assassinate him.

subject: Clan Tharzgad
fact: Clan Tharzgad has been complaining about raids by the Grey Ghosts.
source_quote: Clan Tharzgad has been complaining about raids by the Grey Ghosts.

subject: Clan Xundom
fact: Clan Xundom will support the Deepking if war breaks out.
source_quote: some, like Clan Xundom, will support the Deepking if war breaks out.

subject: Stone Guard bribery
fact: Rumors suggest the Stone Guard have been taking bribes since the Deepking’s madness took over.
source_quote: There are rumors of the Stone Guards taking bribes... They were until a few months ago when the madness of the Deepking took over.

subject: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
fact: Daz explains that Drow NDAs promise horrible outcomes for breaches, but his group can only promise a ghost haunting.
source_quote: The NDAs of the Drow promised all kinds of horrible outcomes to the party that revealed anything. We can only promise the haunting of a ghost.

subject: NDA price negotiation
fact: Daz offers a 1000 gold NDA discount, then raises it to 1100 after Werz questions the price.
source_quote: 1250 gold is our normal NDA price... we would be willing to go down to a flat 1000... If you question it again, it goes to 1100.

subject: Werz pays 1100 gold for NDA
fact: Werz hands over 1100 gold pieces to finalize the NDA.
source_quote: Werz snarls and then looks at Grygum... “I am a merchant, I have to question every price.”... “1100,” snarls Daz.

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Werz says he can help facilitate a weapons deal with Blingdenstone.
source_quote: you are looking to get to Blingdenstone. The gnomes have been trying to make deals with the clans for weapons. I can help facilitate such a deal.

subject: Clan Ironshadow
fact: Clan Ironshadow’s leader is willing to wait out the Deepking’s madness.
source_quote: Clan Ironshadow’s clan leader is willing to wait out the Deepking’s madness

subject: Werz’s motive
fact: Werz claims he only cares about trade and getting rid of his assassin problem.
source_quote: Werz doesn’t care about politics; he only cares about trade. And I only care about gEttin g rid of my assassin's problem.
